text: This week, CMP2946 (Chandler Martin Page), a salesman from the Regional Sales team, triggered rule R4 due to atypical browsing behavior. Specifically, they visited job-search sites 7 times this week, which is significantly above their typical range of 0 visits in recent weeks and below the peer average of 1 visit among same-role peers. This anomaly stands out as CMP2946's usual online activity does not suggest a need for job searching.
